patterns.applicability: Observed ILME-FX6V firmware 6.00, ordinary proxy recording; not chunk mode.
patterns.naming_rule: Clip/{name}.MXF; Clip/{name}M01.XML; Sub/{name}S03.MP4; Thmbnl/{name}T01.JPG. Names may contain spaces. Manifest URIs override suffix hints.
patterns.status_reason: Factory family plus read-only XML relationships on available SD sample.
patterns.grouping_notes: MEDIAPRO.XML Contents/Material gives original URI and nested Proxy/RelevantInfo URIs; scope UMID to the source and recording root.
patterns.limitations: Missing proxy is permitted. Root-level Sub and unrelated test folders are not part of this pattern. Device serial is not card serial.

files.condition: Referenced Material or compatible sidecar identity.

metadata.meaning: Original relative URI; never an OS absolute path.
Related metadata or thumbnail, with type attribute.
Camera media identifier, not physical card or volume serial.
Camera model; Device/@serialNo identifies camera only.
Camera clip creation time including recorded timezone offset.

evidence.supports: FX6 proxy naming, SD PRIVATE prefix; chunk mode documented separately.
Actual directories, all 103 original/proxy references, sidecar namespace and selectors.

patterns.applicability: Documented ILCE-7M4; observed ILME-FX3A sidecars on mixed SD card.
patterns.naming_rule: CLIP/{name}.MP4 and {name}M01.XML; SUB/{name}S03.MP4 on observed FX3A sample.
patterns.status_reason: Documented directory layout and sampled sidecar/proxy pairing.
patterns.grouping_notes: CLIP is original group; SUB is optional related proxy, never another original group. Confirm identity from camera metadata.
patterns.limitations: Do not assume every Sony MP4 is a proxy; filename suffix observation is limited to the sampled mode.

evidence.supports: SD PRIVATE/M4ROOT/CLIP and SUB.
FX3A sidecar model, original/proxy layout and THMBNL directory; sample-specific naming.

patterns.applicability: ILCE-7M4 documented CFexpress layout, not SD prefix.
patterns.naming_rule: M4ROOT/CLIP contains originals; M4ROOT/SUB contains proxies; actual clip prefix is camera configurable.
patterns.status_reason: Manufacturer folder diagram; no physical CFexpress sample required.
patterns.grouping_notes: Associate optional SUB media with original CLIP metadata.
patterns.limitations: No claim of identical metadata namespace across Sony firmware.

evidence.supports: CFexpress root M4ROOT, CLIP and SUB.

patterns.applicability: FX6 v6 chunk transfer mode; original and chunks can reside on different cards.
patterns.naming_rule: Proxy filenames add chunk numbering and S03; destination differs for SD and CFexpress.
patterns.status_reason: Full cross-card chunk association contract still required.
patterns.grouping_notes: Chunks refer to one original recording, not standalone clips.
patterns.limitations: A proxy-only source is incomplete until the original source is available.

files.condition: Chunk mode, explicit original/chunk association required.

evidence.supports: Chunk destination and numbering; separate from ordinary Sub layout.

patterns.applicability: XDCAM EX layout documented by Clip Browsing Software.
patterns.naming_rule: BPAV/CLPR/{clip directory}/{clip files}; index at BPAV/MEDIAPRO.XML, CUEUP.XML; take data in TAKR.
patterns.status_reason: Manufacturer media structure.
patterns.grouping_notes: CLPR members and TAKR/index relationships describe clip/take grouping.
patterns.limitations: Preserve spanning relationships; a file count is not a logical clip count.

evidence.supports: BPAV, CLPR, TAKR and file/index layout.

patterns.applicability: XDCAM media layout in Clip Browsing Software manual, not all MXF media.
patterns.naming_rule: Clip/{clip}.MXF with {clip}M01.XML; media/disc index alongside Clip, Edit, Sub.
patterns.status_reason: Manufacturer structure diagram.
patterns.grouping_notes: Use MEDIAPRO.XML identity and related media references.
patterns.limitations: Root dot is only a candidate when the camera index and expected directories exist.

evidence.supports: XDCAM MXF directory diagram, MXF/sidecar naming and indexes.

patterns.applicability: P2 AVC-Intra layout documented for AG-CX10.
patterns.naming_rule: CONTENTS/VIDEO, AUDIO, CLIP, ICON, PROXY, VOICE; LASTCLIP.TXT beside CONTENTS.
patterns.status_reason: Factory P2 specification.
patterns.grouping_notes: CLIP XML links video, audio and spanned parts.
patterns.limitations: Audio MXF is a component, not another video clip.

evidence.supports: P2 folders and file roles.
Linked-file handling and LASTCLIP.TXT.

patterns.applicability: AG-CX10 AVC-G50/G25/G12 modes.
patterns.naming_rule: CONTENTS/AVCLIP/*.MXF plus CLIP/*.XML.
patterns.status_reason: Manufacturer mode-specific diagram.
patterns.grouping_notes: Logical clip from P2 metadata.
patterns.limitations: Do not force separate AUDIO/VIDEO layout on AVCLIP mode.

evidence.supports: Multiplexed AVCLIP variant.

patterns.applicability: AG-CX10 MOV/MP4 recording.
patterns.naming_rule: PRIVATE/PANA_GRP/{format directory}/{recording}; numbered mode-specific directory, not one fixed name.
patterns.status_reason: Factory directory diagram.
patterns.grouping_notes: Retain INDEX.DAT and BACKUP.TMP associations.
patterns.limitations: Format-folder mapping needs explicit mode evidence.

evidence.supports: MOV/MP4 directory family.

patterns.applicability: AG-CX10 AVCHD; shared standard does not identify manufacturer by itself.
patterns.naming_rule: PRIVATE/AVCHD/BDMV/STREAM/00000.MTS numbering example; CLIPINF and PLAYLIST describe recordings.
patterns.status_reason: Factory AVCHD directory diagram.
patterns.grouping_notes: Use playlist/clip information for split recordings.
patterns.limitations: Do not count transport-stream pieces as independent takes.

evidence.supports: AVCHD directory tree and numbered MTS recording; actual binary relationship parser remains to be validated.

patterns.applicability: Models covered by Canon Software Guide; not a general Cinema EOS/XF profile.
patterns.naming_rule: DCIM/{xxx___mm or xxx_mmdd}/MVI_nnnn.MOV or .AVI; optional same-stem .THM; xxx=100..999, mm/month, dd/day, nnnn=4 digits.
patterns.status_reason: Manufacturer naming and directory specification.
patterns.grouping_notes: THM belongs to same-stem movie; no proxy assumption for MOV.
patterns.limitations: DCF alone does not identify Canon. Respect the documented folder shape and model scope.

files.condition: Numeric folder/name fields per naming rule.
Numeric date folder and clip number.

evidence.supports: Exact folder/filename shapes and thumbnail role.

patterns.applicability: C70 MP4 mode; XF-AVC and newer firmware naming need separate records.
patterns.naming_rule: DCIM/xxx_mmdd; original MVI_nnnn.MP4, sub-recording MVISnnnn.MP4, continuous MVICnnnn.MP4.
patterns.status_reason: Full original/sub/continuous pairing and firmware variants still need manufacturer section validation.
patterns.grouping_notes: Sub-recording is not automatically an editing proxy; require mode and identity.
patterns.limitations: Do not promote every MP4 to an original or label every MVIS as proxy.

evidence.supports: DCIM and numbered movie naming; complete pairing remains pending.

patterns.family: RDM/RDC R3D with optional ProRes proxy
patterns.applicability: KOMODO-X v1.0 R3D + ProRes Proxy mode; REDCINE structure reference.
patterns.naming_rule: {reel}.RDM/{clip}.RDC contains .R3D segments, .mov proxy segments and .rtn thumbnail.
patterns.status_reason: Factory format/mode and directory specification.
patterns.grouping_notes: One RDC groups a logical recording. Resolve segment order and original/proxy relation from recording metadata.
patterns.limitations: Multiple segments are not multiple clips. MOV is proxy only in the documented R3D+proxy mode.

files.condition: R3D+ProRes Proxy mode and original group.
Optional REDCINE edit sidecar, not necessarily camera-created.

evidence.supports: RDM/RDC hierarchy, R3D/MOV/RTN roles and multiple MOV segments.
RMD semantics and legacy R3D segmentation.

patterns.applicability: KOMODO-X v1.0 ProRes mode.
patterns.naming_rule: {reel}.RDM/{clip}.RDC/*.mov.
patterns.status_reason: Factory ProRes-only directory specification.
patterns.grouping_notes: MOV is original in this mode, with segments grouped under RDC.
patterns.limitations: Missing R3D alone cannot prove ProRes-only mode; it could be an incomplete copy.

evidence.supports: ProRes-only hierarchy and MOV originals.

patterns.applicability: ALEXA SUP9.0 and separately cited modern ARRIRAW examples, not one universal ARRI schema.
patterns.naming_rule: Reel directories with reel/clip/time/camera fields in media names; A001R33F and A_0001_12NR are documented examples, not fixed folder names.
patterns.status_reason: Split older SxS/modern Codex and ARRIRAW/HDE/ProRes modes before enabling analysis.
patterns.grouping_notes: Use reel+clip identity and ARRI metadata; companion XML/ALE are not media.
patterns.limitations: MXF container does not determine ARRIRAW, HDE or DNxHD. HDE may be generated after recording.

evidence.supports: SUP9 directory/file examples and companion metadata.
Modern reel, filename and codec-marker distinctions.

patterns.applicability: Cinema Camera 6K, October 2023 manual; CFexpress/USB recording.
patterns.naming_rule: Original BRAW recordings and a proxy subdirectory on the same medium.
patterns.status_reason: Exact filename association and recording-root placement need further factory specification.
patterns.grouping_notes: Optional H.264 proxy belongs to BRAW original; not an independent clip.
patterns.limitations: Do not generalize URSA Cine naming to this model without evidence.

evidence.supports: BRAW original, proxy directory, H.264 proxy recording.

patterns.applicability: URSA Cine documented recording-directory layout.
patterns.naming_rule: Example A001_08151512_C001.braw; Proxy/{same basename}.mp4. Preserve companion BRAW2 when present.
patterns.status_reason: Manufacturer file naming and same-basename proxy description.
patterns.grouping_notes: Same basename within recording root links Proxy to BRAW; BRAW2 is companion data.
patterns.limitations: Physical media mount/reel container is separate from this recording-relative pattern.

files.condition: Associated split sensor data, not another clip.

evidence.supports: Naming, Proxy pairing and companion recording files.

patterns.applicability: Z9 NEV or ProRes RAW MOV with MP4 proxy.
patterns.naming_rule: Configurable three-character prefix, underscore, four-digit number; same-name MP4 proxy for RAW video.
patterns.status_reason: Naming verified; full recording-folder variants still need factory documentation.
patterns.grouping_notes: NEV/MOV RAW original and MP4 same-stem proxy; MOV RAW requires recorded mode.
patterns.limitations: MOV and MP4 can be original recordings in other modes. No extension-only inference.

files.condition: Same-name RAW original and mode required.

evidence.supports: Naming and RAW/proxy relationship, not complete directory tree.

patterns.applicability: Standard layout illustrated by GoPro Labs; filenames may be customized by Labs.
patterns.naming_rule: DCIM/100GOPRO example GX013784.MP4 with GL013784.LRV; chapter/name mapping requires camera mode.
patterns.status_reason: Factory layout example and naming controls.
patterns.grouping_notes: LRV is low-resolution related video; resolve chapter identity before grouping.
patterns.limitations: Do not assume identical stems or one MP4 per logical recording.

evidence.supports: Standard directory and differing MP4/LRV prefixes.
Default and configurable filenames.

patterns.applicability: Labs HERO10 Premiere; HERO11-13 Premiere/DaVinci per factory page.
patterns.naming_rule: DCIM/100GOPRO example: original GX013784.MP4; Proxies/GX013784_Proxy.MP4 or Proxy/GX013784.MP4.
patterns.status_reason: Manufacturer proxy directory and naming specification.
patterns.grouping_notes: Match suffix-adjusted or identical basename in the specified proxy subfolder.
patterns.limitations: Labs option changes layout; a nested proxy MP4 is never another original.

evidence.supports: Two optional NLE proxy layouts and model scope.

patterns.applicability: Models listed by DJI LRF support article; not a generic DJI drone profile.
patterns.naming_rule: LRF is camera-generated preview media; directory and original naming are not specified by the cited article.
patterns.status_reason: Need full factory directory and original/preview association rules, not extensions only.
patterns.grouping_notes: LRF belongs to a recording and supports playback/trim download.
patterns.limitations: LRF alone does not identify a model or prove edit-proxy compatibility.

evidence.supports: Preview role and applicable product family only.

patterns.applicability: ProHD Clip Manager documented SD and SxS layouts.
patterns.naming_rule: SD PRIVATE/JVC/BPAV; SxS BPAV; CLPR holds per-clip directories.
patterns.status_reason: Factory media folder structure.
patterns.grouping_notes: Use index and per-clip metadata, including spanned recordings.
patterns.limitations: BPAV alone cannot distinguish JVC from Sony.

evidence.supports: SD/SxS root alternatives and CLPR hierarchy.

patterns.applicability: GY-HM790 HD MPEG-2 MOV mode.
patterns.naming_rule: PRIVATE/JVC/CQAV recordings; configurable clip prefix and sequence number.
patterns.status_reason: Manufacturer recording-folder/naming specification.
patterns.grouping_notes: Preserve linked parts across files/cards.
patterns.limitations: MOV mode is distinct from BPAV MP4; verify split ordering in the future parser.

evidence.supports: CQAV mode-specific directory, configurable clip names and splitting.

gaps.missing_evidence: Manufacturer directory trees and split/sidecar/proxy identities for each mode; do not turn XF Utility compatibility lists into structural rules.
Factory recording folder, naming and original/proxy association. Known proxy menu options alone are insufficient.
PRIVATE/PXROOT/Clip is documented proxy destination; original lives on another recorder/media. Need full cross-media identity, not a new original rule.
Separate factory folder/naming/metadata specifications by camera, firmware and recording media; do not assume XDROOT.
Mode-specific factory directory, numbered/chapter identities and optional low-resolution media relationships.
Factory folder/naming details by recording mode and proxy feature; not inferred from P2.

gaps.family: OM System, Leica, Sigma, Insta360, Canon/Sony/Nikon still-image variants, external recorders
gaps.missing_evidence: Open coverage backlog, not a support claim. Obtain manufacturer recording specifications before adding enabled patterns.
